summary: `feed` with no subcommand pages Digg's MCP tool digg_get_feed for one topic as JSON lines, deduplicated by id, ending with a cursor line a later run resumes from; scores (diggScore, sourceCount, uniqueAuthors) come from one walk of the same topic's ranked feed (/api/feed/continuous), joined by story UUID with the URL short id as fallback; it never prints or decodes a tldr or description; a refusal on either feed (HTTP 429 or a 'Retry after' / 'Search resets at' tool error) ends the run at once with exit 7, the reset time Digg named (uncapped) and the cursor to resume from.
reason: A collector shares one rate budget with every other caller, and Digg says early retries lengthen its penalty, so the CLI must hand the wait back instead of sleeping or retrying. digg_get_feed sends no score or source counts; the ranked feed (robots.txt disallows /api/; the maintainer chose to use it for scores) carries them under the same story UUIDs, checked live 2026-11-21. Neither feed carries a first-source time, so firstSourceAt stays null rather than a guessed value.
validated_outcome: Live: `feed --topic ai --view top --range 7d --max-pages 1` scored 20 of 20 posts from one ranked page; on ai/top/7d all 20 digg_get_feed ids were ranked-feed clusterIds and every short id mapped to the same UUID. Offline fakes cover cursor resume, the --since stop, id dedupe, the UUID and short-id joins, ranked walk bounds, 429 on either feed with no retry and exit 7, and the absence of tldr/description.
